title: althaea phoenicea
intro: Althaea phoenicea, commonly known as marshmallow plant, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Althaea phoenicea include its soothing and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to calm digestive issues, such as irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its mucilaginous properties, which can help to protect and soothe the mucous membranes, as well as its antioxidant and antimicrobial actions. The bioactive constituents of Althaea phoenicea include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
